csc_special_traits: Plant height: 6.0 m. Plant type: Vines are large, hairy and spreading. Leaf characters: Large, silvery green, hairy and lobed leaves with long petioles. Flower characters: Monoeciuos, male and female flowers are yellow and solitary, male flower with long pedicle but female flowers are almost sessile. Fruit characters: The fruits are green in immature stage and white in full mature stage. They are cylindrical, rind colour green, immature fruits are pubescent, cylindrical (Av. Length-23.50 cm and girth-55.0 cm). Mature fruits have a dense pelt of minute hairs and covered with a white waxy bloom. The average fruits weight is 7 kg and average number of fruits per plant is 3.10. The fruit flesh is white and seeds are creamy white in colour. Suitable for both summer and rainy seasons I both in south and north India. Responds well to optimum doses of nitrogenous fertilizers. Requires more moisture for rapid development at early stage of crop growth. Tender fruits cooked as vegetable, mature fruits used for candy (petha) and Badi preparation. Excellent storage and transport quality. Resistant to cucumber mosaic virus and water melon mosaic virus and other major diseases and insects.

csc_additional_notes: General regulatory guidelines and conditions for consideration of proposals for release and notification of Horticultural crop & variety by the committee:, 1. Sponsoring Institute/organization should ensure that the proposals are submitted in proper format and must have the required documents viz., acknowledgement certificate regarding submission of seed sample with NBPGR, detailed morphological characters of varieties, AICRP data on disease and pests reaction, source of material and pedigree, package of practices of the cultivar, DNA fingerprinting profile, A-4 size coloured photographs on glossy sheet etc., 2. The committee will not consider any proposal for release or notification in case the copy of proposal is not submitted to respective Director/Project Coordinator., 3. The proposals will be submitted through email (cvrc.hort-agri@gov.in). Five signed original hard copies will be submitted to Deputy Commissioner (Quality Control), DAC&FW, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi for records., 4. Each sponsoring institution/breeder will make of the proposal., 5. ICAR Institutes, SAUs and other organizations should devise a naming system of the name of Institute followed by crop name and then serial number of variety. Proposals with names of family members, gods and goddesses will not be accepted., 6. Any proposal with more than five years old data will not be considered by the committee., Meeting closure note: The meeting ended with a vote of thanks to the Chair.

csc_additional_notes: Sponsoring State and Year of Release: Uttarakhand/2008. First picking in 80-100 days after transplanting in mid hills.
csc_breeding_method: Introduction and selection from AVRDC line 9955-36 (EC 565199).
csc_agro_climatic_zones: Uttarakhand hills under irrigated and rainfed conditions
csc_special_traits: Plant height: 70-80 cm. Growth habit: Erect. Branching habit: Intermediate. Flower size: Medium. Leaf shape: Ovate. Leaf colour: Green. Days to 50% flowering days: 50-60. Days to maturity: 80-100. Fruit shape: Blocky. Blossom end of fruit shape: Sunken. Fruit shape at pedical attachment: Lobate. Fruit position: Pendent. Fruit lobe: 3-4. Fruit size: Medium. Fruit surface (smooth/wrinkled): Smooth. Fruit colour(immature): Dark green. Fruit colour(Mature): Dark red. No. of fruit per plant: 10-20. Av. Fruit length (cm): 6.2. Av. Fruit diameter: 5.1. Av. Fruit weight (g): 45-50. Thickness of pericarp (cm): 0.25. Seed colour: Deep yellow (straw). Seed size: Medium. 100 seed wt.: 0.51. Plants are vigorous, tall and stems are strong with green foliage. Branching is just like chilli plant. The fruits are medium, bell shape and dark green in colour with smooth surface. Mature fruits are dark red. Fruits are slightly narrow in shape towards distal end. Fruit length and diameter ratio is >1 (1.21%). Resistant to fruit rot & seedling rot complex. Resistant to fruit, wilt and powdery mildew.

csc_additional_notes: Seed rate - Direct sowing 6 Kg/ha. Transplanted 1.5-1.6 kg/ha. Spacing Rainfed 60 x 15 cm, Irrigated 75 x 30 cm.
csc_special_traits: Plant height: 80-85cm. Distinguishing morphological characters: Plant growth habit Medium & spreading, Stem pubescence Glabrous, Stem colour Green, Leaf pubescence Glabrous, No. of Pedicles/axils One, Pedicle position at anthesis Pendent, Corolla colour White, Fruit position Declining, Fruit colour in immature stage Light green, Fruit colour in mature stage Red. Characteristics different from those of the parents: Fruits are slender and light green in colour when immature. Maturity (range in number of days): 50% flowering was observed after 65-70 days after transplanting. Maturity Group: Early (160-170 days). Agronomical features: Crop response well to fertilizer application up to 300 kgN, 60 kg P2O5 and 120 kg K2O/ha. Reaction to environmental stresses: Moderately tolerant to drought. Description of parents: LCA-305 (Plant height 65-75 cm, Plants are bushy with lengthy branches with yellow anthers, Days to 50% flowering 85-90 days, Maturity ripening 185-190 days, Reaction to major disease Fairly tolerant to viruses and leaf spot diseases, Reaction to major pests Moderately tolerant to sucking pests, thrips, mites and aphids, Crop responds well to recommended doses fertilizers). Selection 116 (Plant height 90-95 cm, Erect and semi-spreading, Days to 50% flowering 60-70 days, Maturity ripening 160-170 days, Reaction to major disease Tolerant to die back and fruit rot, Reaction to major pests Susceptible to sucking pests, Crop responds well to recommended doses of fertilizers).

csc_special_traits: Plant height: 70-80 cm. Leaf colour: Green. Leaf lobing: Absent. Leaf length: 42-45 cm. Leaf width: 20-23 cm. Leaf wt.: 550-650 g. Leaf apex shape: Ovate. Number of leaf/plant: 18-22. Leaf pubescence: Absent. Curd length: 16-17cm. Curd width: 15-16 cm. Curd shape: Semi-Dome shape. Curd texture: Fine. Curd weight: 850-900 g. Branching: Not covered. Days to 50% harvesting: 75-80 days. Maturity (Days seed to seed): 210-220 days. Reaction to environmental stress: Tolerant to high temperature and humid condition during vegetative growth. Characteristics different from those of parents: Intermediate stalk, petiole and leaf lamina and vigorous growing habit. Maturity (range in number of days): Seedlings are ready after 22-25 days of sowing for transplanting. Takes about 70-68 days for curd formation. Maturity Group: The variety belongs to Mid maturity group of cauliflower. Agronomical features: Optimum temperature for curd initiation and development is 25-27-C. Suitable for mid sown conditions (Second week of August to Last week of the September) and ready for harvest from mid November to late December under north Indian plains. Quality attributes purpose for which recommended: Retentive white, medium sized and compact curd. For table purpose. Table quality attributes/Nutritional quality: White compact curd, free from bracts and riceyness. Reaction to environmental stresses: It can withstand high temperature and high rainfall during its vegetative growth. Reaction to major diseases: Moderately resistant to downy mildew. Average yield under normal condition: 215 qtl./ha.

csc_additional_notes: General regulatory guidelines and conditions for consideration of proposals for release and notification of Horticultural crop & variety by the committee:, 1. Sponsoring Institute/organization should ensure that the proposals are submitted in proper format and must have the required documents viz., acknowledgement certificate regarding submission of seed sample with NBPGR, detailed morphological characters of varieties, AICRP data on disease and pests reaction, source of material and pedigree, package of practices of the cultivar, DNA fingerprinting profile, A-4 size coloured photographs on glossy sheet etc., 2. The committee will not consider any proposal for release or notification in case the copy of proposal is not submitted to respective Director/Project Coordinator., 3. The proposals will be submitted through email (cvrc.hort-agri@gov.in). Five signed original hard copies will be submitted to Deputy Commissioner (Quality Control), DAC&FW, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi for records., 4. Each sponsoring institution/breeder will make of the proposal., 5. ICAR Institutes, SAUs and other organizations should devise a naming system of the name of Institute followed by crop name and then serial number of variety. Proposals with names of family members, gods and goddesses will not be accepted., 6. Any proposal with more than five years old data will not be considered by the committee., Meeting closure note: The meeting ended with a vote of thanks to the Chair.

csc_special_traits: Plant height: 45-50 cm. Distinguishing morphological characters: Dark red coloured bulbs, stripes on bulb, oval shape, very less number of bolters and doubles in Rabi, thin neck, number of leaves ranged from 8-12, TSS 10-10.5%. Number of leaves: 8-12/plant. Polar Diameter (P): 42-45 cm. Equatorial Diameter (E): 45-50 cm. P.E.: 0.85-0.95. Neck thickness: 0.6-0.8cm. % Total soluble solids: 10-10.5. Days to harvest after transplanting: 100-105 days in Kharif, 115-120 day in Rabi. Characters different from those of the parents: Bulbs oval in shape and single centred. Maturity (range in number of days): 115-120 day after transplanting in Rabi and 100-105 days in Kharif. Maturity Group: Early in Kharif and medium in Rabi. Agronomical features: Erect Plant habit, less pseudostem length, minimum neck thickness of the bulb, uniform neck fall during Rabi, early in maturity. Quality attributes purpose for which recommended: Table/processing/export. Table quality attributes/Nutritional quality: Attractive red colour, suitable for immediate consumption. Single centered, suitable for salad, pungent. Reaction to major diseases: Field tolerance to foliar diseases. Reaction to major pests: Field tolerance to thrips. Average yield under normal condition: 250-300 qtls/ha.
csc_parent_material: Dark red colour and duration resembles with Baswant 780, A.Kalyan and N-53.
csc_maturity_group: Early in Kharif and medium in Rabi

csc_special_traits: Medium duration. Medium maturity, field resistant to late blade. High dry matter. Plant height: 70-80 cm. Haulms: Medium tall, semi-erect, plant canopy, semi-compact, vigorous. Stem: Many, medium thick, predominantly green with red-brown secondary pigment randomly distributed, wings feebly developed and wavy. Leaf: Intermediate, dark grey green, smooth, glossy, rachis, green. Large and many. Leaflets: Width medium, ovate-Lanceolate, margin entire, coalescence absent, midrib green. Folioles: Many, small. Foliage colour: Green. Tubers: Size medium, long oblong, white cream, smooth, eyes shallow, normal eyebrows, flesh white, texture mealy. Sprout: Red purple with green at the apex, shape spherical, pubescence of base slight and tip closed. Dormancy: Medium. Stolen: Medium. Flowers: Light red, moderate flowering, flower stalk green, calyx green, bud red, pedicel articulation above the middle, corolla primarily light red with tip on both sides white, corolla shape stellate, anthers orange, pollen fertile, anther cone normally developed, style longer than stamen column and stigma bio-lobed. Specific gravity: 1.093. Dry matter: 22.4 per cent. Cooking quality: Good. Texture: Floury. Stem-end discolouration: None. Medium maturing with Good keeping, responsive to fertilizers. Field resistant to late blight (Phystophthora infestans).

csc_special_traits: Plant height: 120-140cm. Distinguishing morphological characters: Plant habit Tall & Spreading, Foliage colour Green stem and green foliage (leaves), Fruit characteristics: Fruits green, Long average weight 50-55 g, No of Branches 12-16, Days to 50% flowering 45-50 days, Days to first harvesting 60-65 days, Fruit length 22-24 cm, Fruit diameter 2.43 cm, Number of fruits per plant 30-34, Average fruit weight 50-55 g. Maturity (range in number of days): 50% flowering - 45-50 days after transplanting. Maturity Group: Early (Maturity-60-65 days after transplanting). Agronomical features: Growing season - Kharif and Rabi, Response to fertility - high (180-150-120 NPK kgs/ha). Quality of produce: Fruits are green long, has good cooking quality. Reaction to environmental stresses: Resistant to Bacterial Wilt. Description of parents: Female Parent (IIHR-3) - Plant height 90-100 cm, Plant habit Medium Tall, Foliage colour Green, Fruit shape Long, Stem end scar Medium, Colour of ripening red Yellow, Maturity (days seed to seed) 60-65 days, Maturity (from transplanting to first harvest) 70-75 days, Maturity Group (Medium), Resistant to BW. Male Parent (IIHR-322) - Plant height 70-80 cm, Plant habit Erect, Foliage colour Light green, Fruit shape Short, Stem end scar Absent, Colour of ripening red Yellow, Maturity (days seed to seed) 55-60 days, Maturity (from transplanting to first harvest) 65-70 days, Maturity Group (Early), Resistant to BW. Reaction to major diseases: BWBH-3 has resistance to Bacterial Wilt. Resistant to Rolstonia solancecearum race-1 and biovar-3. Reaction to major pests: Less incidence of shoot & fruit borer was observed.

csc_institution: Vivekananda Parvatiya Krishi Anusandhan Sansthan (VPKAS), ICAR
developer_institution_csc: Vivekananda Parvatiya Krishi Anusandhan Sansthan (VPKAS), ICAR
csc_additional_notes: Sponsoring State and Year of Release: Uttarakhand/2008.
csc_breeding_method: Derived from a cross between Azad Pea 1 X PRS-18-6-4-5-1. The strain was bulked in F6 generation. PRS-18-6-4-5-1 is a powdery mildew resistant line.
csc_agro_climatic_zones: Uttarakhand hills under irrigated and rainfed conditions
csc_special_traits: Resembles in pod shape and maturity duration with Azad Pea 1. Plant height: 56.4 cm. Growth habit: Dwarf. 50% flowering: 90-100 days (in mid hills). Maturity days: Medium, 132-135 days. Number of branch: 1-2. Node of First flower: 7-10. Foliage colour: Green. Leaf type: Normal. Flower colour: White. No. of flowers/peduncle: Two. Pod colour: Dark green. Pod shape: Curved/sickle. Pods/peduncle: Mostly double. No. of pods/plant: 10-15. No. of pods/kg: 190-200. Av. Pod length: 8.1 cm. No. of seeds/pod: 7-8. 100 green grain weight: 35-40g. Shelling %: 46. Sweetness: Sweet. Seed colour: Greenish wrinkled. 100 seed weight: 21 g. Plants are dwarf, vigorous in growth with dark green foliage. Pods are long, dark green, sickle shaped (strong curvature) and pointed distal end. Seed is greenish wrinkled. Highly resistant to powdery mildew and resistant to wilt, white rot and leaf blight disease under hill conditions. No major pest mentioned.

csc_special_traits: Plant growth habit: Viny, vine length 3.5 - 5.25 m. Distinguishing morphological characteristics: Stem colour Green, Plant type Medium (3.5-5.25 m), Fruit shape Cylindrical, Fruit colour Light green. Fruit size 8-9, Node number at which 1st female flower appears 8-9, No. of fruits per plant 14-16, Number of picking 5-6 times, Days to first harvest 48-50 days, Fruit length 20.0-25.0 cm, Fruit diameter 4.36 cm, Fruit weight 125.36 g, Fruit pulp colour White, Days taken for physiological maturity (Seed to seed) 120-125 days. Description of the parents/variety: Female - Number of branches/vine 8-10, Foliage colour Light green, Stem colour Light green, Average fruit weight (g) 130, Fruit length (cm) 25, Fruit diameter (cm) 9.00, Fruit colour Light green, Number of fruits/plant 12, Yield (q/ha) 219.00, Days to 50% harvest 65-70. Male - Number of branches/vine 9-12, Foliage colour Dark green, Stem colour Dark green, Average fruit weight (g) 165, Fruit length (cm) 28, Fruit diameter (cm) 10.00, Fruit colour Light green, Number of fruits/plant 8, Yield (q/ha) 224.00, Days to 50% harvest 75-80. Agronomic features: It can be grown in summer and rainy season. It can be grown as mixed or inter crop. Suitable for river bed cultivation. Suitable for trellies system. Responsiveness to higher does of fertilizer of 80:60:60 kg N.P.K./ha. Seed rate: 3.5 kg ha-. Sowing time - First fort night of July and First fort night of February. Spacing - 3.5 m row to row and 75 cm plant to plant. Quality attributes: Vegetable purpose and distance marketing (export). Good cooking quality and very tasty. Reaction to environmental stress: More temperature tolerant and late sowing (September - October and March - April). Reaction to major diseases: Resistance to Anthracnose disease and tolerant to downy and powdery mildew. (Parents were Susceptible to Powdery mildew and Downy mildew). Reaction to major pests: Tolerant to leaf minor, fruit fly and Red pumpkin beetle. (Parents had Less Leaf minor).
csc_maturity_group: Seeding to fruit maturity 115-120 days. Maturity on ground: Medium maturity. Maturity/ripening (seed to seed): 130-135 (female parent), 140-145 (male parent).

csc_agro_climatic_zones: Uttarakhand hills under irrigated and rainfed conditions
csc_yield_performance: 100-110 Q/ha (green pods); 16-17 Q/ha (seed); Organic: 162.7 (120-198); Inorganic: 259; Seed: 60-70
csc_special_traits: Plant height: 90.5 cm. Growth habit: Dwarf. 50% flowering: 35 (30-40). Days to first picking/harvest: 60-70. Foliage colour: Green with good cover. No. of primary branch: 2-4. Leaf type & Leaf size: Standard/Normal. Leaf colour: Green. Leaf cover: Good. Stem thickness: Thick. Pubescence - Stem, Leaf & Petiole: Present. Pigmentation (stem, Petiole): Absent. Flower size: Big. Flower colour: Yellow. Style position: Non exerted. Fruit colour: Light green (green) and Attractive red (ripe). Blossom end: Round. Fruit shape and surface: Round and smooth. Av. Number of locules: 4-5. Fruits/clusters: 10-35. Fruit weight: 75 g (60-100g). Fruit weight (re-mentioned): 0.5. Flesh thickness (cm): 5.0. TSS (Brix) (listed as): Pulpy. Fruit pulpiness (listed as): Firm. Fruit firmness (listed as): None. Fruit cracking: None. Fruit abnormalities (cat face): Medium. Seediness: 0.37 g. 100 seed wt.: 0.31 g. Seed wt./Fruit: Very good. Keeping quality: 200-300. Suitability: NA. Plants are indeterminate vigorous in growth with standard leaf type. The immature fruits are light green colour. The mature fruits are medium large, smooth round shaped and dark red in colour with slight locular impression. Resistant to fruit, wilt and powdery mildew.

csc_additional_notes: Proposal discussed in 54th, 56th, 57th & 58th subcommittee meetings. Reconsidered based on updated data and detailed review. Yellow rust is pre-dominant in NWPZ, and HD-2967's performance against it is comparatively better than other varieties. Disease reaction data varies inconsistently across years due to environmental conditions. Confirmed by Chairman Central Seed Committee on 2011-09-08.
csc_yield_performance: Slightly higher yield than checks after 3 and 4 years of testing. At par in yield with DBW 17 and significantly superior than PBW 343.
csc_special_traits: Resistant reaction to Stripe Rust pathotypes 78 S 84 (R in seedling stage, 0 in adult stage) and 46 S 119 (MR in seedling stage, 0 in adult stage). Resistant reaction to Brown Rust pathotypes 77-5 (R in seedling, TR in adult) and 104-2 (R in seedling, 0 in adult). Possesses different combination of genes for resistance against predominant pathotypes viz. 78 S 84 of yellow rust and 77-5 and 104-2 of brown rust. Shows presence of minor genes for enhanced resistance to yellow rust.

csc_meeting_title: Minutes of the 28th meeting of Central Sub-Committee on Crop Standards, Notification and Release of Varieties for Horticultural Crops
csc_additional_notes: General regulatory guidelines and conditions for consideration of proposals for release and notification of Horticultural crop & variety by the committee:, 1. Sponsoring Institute/organization should ensure that the proposals are submitted in proper format and must have the required documents viz., acknowledgement certificate regarding submission of seed sample with NBPGR, detailed morphological characters of varieties, AICRP data on disease and pests reaction, source of material and pedigree, package of practices of the cultivar, DNA fingerprinting profile, A-4 size coloured photographs on glossy sheet etc., 2. The committee will not consider any proposal for release or notification in case the copy of proposal is not submitted to respective Director/Project Coordinator., 3. The proposals will be submitted through email (cvrc.hort-agri@gov.in). Five signed original hard copies will be submitted to Deputy Commissioner (Quality Control), DAC&FW, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi for records., 4. Each sponsoring institution/breeder will make of the proposal., 5. ICAR Institutes, SAUs and other organizations should devise a naming system of the name of Institute followed by crop name and then serial number of variety. Proposals with names of family members, gods and goddesses will not be accepted., 6. Any proposal with more than five years old data will not be considered by the committee., Meeting closure note: The meeting ended with a vote of thanks to the Chair.
